instruction: Use case: precise hairstyle-only transparent game sprite edit. INPUT 1 is the approved original portrait and alignment template. INPUT 2 is optional in-game feedback reference, never copy its UI or outfit. Output only the detailed illustrated hairstyling itself for Iris, a 2D dress-up game sprite. True transparency in empty space and in the face, nose, lips, ears, neck, shoulders and clothing. Keep precisely INPUT 1's canvas aspect ratio, portrait hair scale and absolute x/y position relative to its now transparent canvas, and keep its hairline and the eye location for registering to the original doll. Do not center or crop the extracted hairstyle. Its scalp currently starts at around y=120 in a 520x740 normalized portrait, and pupils are at y=270. All existing strands retain their painterly high detail and directional shine, clean smooth pigment edges. The BACKGROUND and all skin, facial features and clothing are fully transparent. Only the original, revised hair is visible. No white silhouette or shapes filling the eye opening. Edit request:

retouches.01-ambre: Keep the existing amber face-framing butterfly shape and tidy the hair texture. Reconnect all accidental holes in the shoulders and lower locks. Let an elegant copper strand sweep in front of the outer third of one eye, and taper into the existing temple layers. Keep the other eye and both central pupils readable.
retouches.02-sienna: Keep the signature straight soft blunt bangs, espresso-brown, and long silky pointed strands. Create noticeably fuller sides and clean continuous ribbons of straight hair along both sides of the neck, including inside the existing lower narrow gaps. Keep an open transparent central face and neck. Slightly more crown volume and wider lower locks but still naturally scaled. No strange gaps or floating streaks.
retouches.04-velvet: Preserve the sleek center part and low asymmetric ponytail, and add elegant, visibly greater volume at the crown and through the length of the tail. From the nape, bring the tail down more vertically and keep it entirely within the shoulder outline and the blue shirt sleeve seen on image 2. Its furthest point must be left of x=350 in a 520-pixel-wide version of image 1. The new broadened tail fills toward the center of the chest. Give the root and length a smooth continuous transition.
retouches.06-eden: Keep the style of the original flowing chestnut waves and the fine braids. Repair small internal holes in the locks so the silhouette is uninterrupted where strands overlap. Draw a few fine temple strands curving in front of the outer third of the eyes as a deliberate layered flourish, keeping pupils readable. Keep the length and size.
retouches.07-raven: Redraw only the spiky fringe into a more cohesive soft asymmetric side-swept fringe with overlapping textured interlocking locks and fine tips. The fringe part is just off-center, weighted to one side, softly borders the viewer-left eyebrow, and complements the blue-black wolf cut. Preserve the silhouette and length of the textured crown, feathered sides and shoulder layers. Keep both eyes clear, avoid isolated little sharp spikes and zig-zag center fringe.
retouches.09-ruby: Retain the existing burgundy curled length and deep side part. Make the glossy side-swept strand fall naturally over the outer third of the eye on the viewer's right, with a clean continuous curved line. Keep the eye on the other side fully visible. Keep the existing style and shape elsewhere.
retouches.10-luna: Retain the brown braided bob, including its small frontal braids. Let the two wisps and the braids sit in front of the temples and subtly cross the outer corners of the eyes, leaving both pupils readable. Tidy the pointed ends so all remaining texture is cohesive and stops at the clavicle, above the shoulder straps. No disconnected shoulder specks, no opaque tan regions or remnants of skin in the temples or face hole.
